title: pp.eqfilter~
description: `pp.eqfilter~` filters an incoming signal using selectable lowpass, highpass, resonant, bandpass, notch, peaking, allpass, lowshelf, or highshelf modes, with coefficients based on Robert Bristow-Johnson’s Audio EQ Cookbook. Control messages set frequency and Q, while gain applies to peaking and shelf filters; the object also supports saving and recalling up to 20 presets.
